pricing.note: gpt-5-mini list price as of 2026-11-16. Cheaper dated judges exist (gpt-5-nano, gpt-4o-mini) but are weaker or share the GPT-4o family with one generator.

status.note: Chat-completions support for this snapshot must be confirmed on the user's account before the first judging run (the check is free and generates nothing). gpt-5-mini is a reasoning-family model: temperature is intentionally NOT sent (the API rejects non-default sampling params on this family). Deliberately a DIFFERENT family from all three generators (Qwen, Llama, GPT-4o) to limit same-family judge bias; gpt-4o-mini was rejected for sharing the GPT-4o family with one generating model.

notes: Judge for the automated adherence evaluator. Pinned dated snapshot, separate from the three generating models. The judge receives device rule + rubric + reasoning text (+ optional mechanical evidence) and returns a structured JSON verdict. Do not raise max_output_tokens casually: judge output is a compact JSON object; a 'length' finish_reason is treated as judge_output_truncated, not a verdict.
